prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Spectrum 1-6: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F27, accent #86241D, secondary surface #EAEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
